newsitem.title: CHINA: Seven China listed firms undergo restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Seven China listed firms undergo restructuring.

text.p: Seven Chinese listed companies underwent shareholding restructuring last week, reflecting a growing trend, the official Shanghai Securities News reported on Saturday.
Most of the seven domestic currency A share companies had their so-called legal person shares, which are not traded, transferred to new shareholders by the original owners, it said.
Stock transfers were becoming more frequent and the size of the transfers larger, the report said, adding these moves helped provide new capital and encouraged company mergers.
China is currently attempting to reform its state enterprise system by allowing companies to merge or go bankrupt in order to be able to meet the challenges of the market economy.
Such transfers had little immediate effect on the listed company, the newspaper said.
